direction: Date-and-place card over an establishing wide shot. Grey spring morning on the inland hilltop at Llandough. A small early-medieval church of rough stone with a thatched roof stands inside a low earth-and-stone churchyard bank, with a few simple grave markers in the grass. Beyond the bank the land falls away to the Ely, its marshes, and the estuary as a pale far-off sheen. A freshly dug socket pit waits beside the church door. Slow push in.
